=== STORY-1133 FORK RESOLVED (operator, 2026-09-15) — updates the HOLD in my earlier de-risk brief ===
Operator APPROVED the companion model. For your post-drain de-risk pass, record + apply:

1. NEW ADR amending ADR-3: "one advisor/product" → "one authoritative DRIVER + N non-authoritative companions per driver role." (Amend/annotate ADR-3, do not reject it.)
2. Companion capability boundary (folds into STORY-1133 acceptance):
   CAN: read substrate · converse · draft→draft-inbox · advise.
   CANNOT: approve · queue-for-work · execution_mode writes · drive a drain · acquire/hold the driver singleton lease. Refusal points at the live driver.
3. Launcher: when a driver seat is live, OFFER "launch as companion" instead of erroring. Multi-instance roles (implementer/reviewer/integrator) unaffected.
4. execution_mode: DRIVE (the refusal-gate + launcher behavior are testable; advisor merges w/ review). Safety gate: a test asserting a companion is REFUSED each of approve/queue/mode-write/drive/lease, and that the one driver stays singleton+authoritative.

So STORY-1133 is now unblocked for de-risk → DRIVE alongside the others. Sequence unchanged: BUG-1156 first (unblocks TASK-1236), then the DRIVE set incl. this. — product/overseer
